# Chapter 2: Assessing Your Business Needs

## The Importance of Starting with Assessment

Before diving into specific AI tools or technologies, it's crucial to understand exactly where AI can make the biggest impact in your business. Jumping straight to implementation without proper assessment often leads to wasted time, money, and frustration on solutions that don't address your real pain points.
